nodes.question: Why was the ICONA model selected for the study?
nodes.answer: The ICONA model was selected due to its higher spatial and temporal resolution, which is advantageous for the remote sensing data used in the study and allows for precise spatial mapping necessary for accurate soil erosion assessment.
